summary: Date and time inputs with constraints: a bounded DatePicker, a required DatePicker with an error, a disabled DateField and a read-only TimeField.
use: Forms that limit selectable dates, require a date of birth or show locked date and time values.
spec: `minValue={min}` and `maxValue={max}` with `const max = today(tz).add({ days: 30 })` and `description="Only the next 30 days."`
`required` with `error={requiredError}` derived as `'Enter your date of birth.'` while empty
